Lean unchanged: ref QOU.QBeta.CKRecursion.CKRecursion is the data structure (depth, kernel : Fin depth -> R), never asserted, so neither the depth-d recursion c_{k+1} = sum a_j c_{k+1-j} nor its derivation from the q-difference equation F(q xi) = R F(xi) is stated or proved. The md change replaces 'We formally prove that' with 'Consequently' (removing a false formal-proof claim, an improvement) and adds the reason that a_j = e_j of j bar-odd rates alternates parity. That reason rests on the same false premise as before: r_lambda = (q-1) mu_lambda is not bar-odd, since q-1 maps to (1-q)/q under q -> 1/q, so the alternation is unsupported. The constant-coefficient recursion from a q-difference equation is still asserted without argument, and 'the recursion generates c_3..c_8 automatically' is unproved. No photon/electron ruling conflict.

trap-superlative.evidence: 'The sequence c_2, ..., c_8 collapses to the PROVED seed c_2 = -1 and a kernel R(q_0, xi) of bounded degree d. The recursion generates c_3, ..., c_8 automatically.' Three problems. (1) 'proved' contradicts a STRICT AGENTS.md correction of 2026-08-16, which rules that 'PROVED IS wrong' for c_2 = -1 and that 'structural' is the defensible word - and the upstream block this one depends on (prop:q-beta-c-2-eq-neg-one-structural) correctly says 'structural identity'. This block silently upgrades its own premise. (2) 'generates c_3, ..., c_8 automatically' is asserted while the block's own computation.status is 'experimental' and neither d nor the a_j is exhibited anywhere in the block. (3) The cyclotomic paragraph names Phi_d for d in {2,3,6} and the primes as self-reciprocal, then the very next sentence states the general fact for every n > 1 - and the sibling .lean now carries the general theorem (cyclotomic_self_reverse), so the special-case list is stale scaffolding that implies the property is special to those n when it is not.
trap-superlative.notes: PROPOSED (not applied - each is a claim-level change): (1) 'the structural seed c_2 = -1'; (2) either exhibit d and the a_j or downgrade to 'is intended to generate', matching the experimental status; (3) drop the special-case list and keep the general statement, citing cyclotomic_self_reverse. ALSO unexplained: 'The identity Phi_n(1/q) q^{phi(n)} = Phi_n(q) guarantees period-3 closure.' The identity is correct for every n > 1 (I checked Phi_2, Phi_3, Phi_6), but nothing in the block defines 'period-3 closure' or connects self-reciprocality to a period, so the inference does not follow as written.
